name: Health Sciences Simulation Center
use: Clinical simulation labs, classrooms and offices for nursing, occupational therapy, communication sciences and other CHHS programs
style: Contemporary: metal and fiber-cement panels with timber-toned entrance

facts.text: Construction began fall 2020 with major funding from the State of New Hampshire, the University System and UNH.
More than 20,000 sq ft with 35 offices, classrooms and simulation labs mimicking hospital, clinic and primary care settings, plus common spaces for interprofessional discussion.
The opening was celebrated on November 8, 2021.
It grew out of $9 million given to UNH in 2019 to address the state's health care worker shortage.
